items.title: Gucci sells 'Made in China' sneakers for 1st time
items.summary: Jing Daily reports Gucci broke decades of Italy-only manufacturing tradition by releasing two sneaker styles (Demna's 'Drip' canvas sneaker and a leather slip-on) made in China, priced around $1,000/$950. Gucci says Italy remains central to its manufacturing identity and denies the move is cost-cutting, citing Chinese manufacturers' technical capability instead.

items.title: Gucci首次认"中国制造"！7000元运动鞋引热议
items.summary: Sina consumer-finance piece on Gucci's first China-made sneakers (roughly 7,050 and 6,380 RMB) breaking with the brand's Italy-only heritage. Quotes Gucci's statement that the shift reflects technical requirements, not cost-cutting, and notes this lands amid the brand's 12th straight quarter of sales decline, raising consumer questions about whether the price is still justified.

items.title: Gucci破天荒！两款新鞋标"中国制造"，售价超七千
items.summary: Weibo fashion-account post amplifying the Made-in-China sneaker news, noting the roughly 7,000 RMB price tag and framing it as unprecedented for the brand. Part of a cluster of similar Weibo posts debating whether China-made luxury sneakers justify their price versus Italian-made equivalents.

items.title: 这款中国制造的Gucci鞋质量会和意大利产有差别吗？
items.summary: Weibo Q&A-style discussion thread where users debate whether the China-made Gucci sneaker's build quality will differ from Italian-made versions, reflecting consumer skepticism/quality-anxiety around the manufacturing shift rather than brand marketing content.

items.title: 古驰悄悄降价最高40%：奢侈品"只涨不降"神话破灭
items.summary: Weibo account '格调风向标' post detailing Gucci's quiet China price cuts (Ophidia mini bucket 30% off, GG Marmont bucket under 10,000 RMB) and quoting a Hangzhou consumer's complaint that brands 'keep raising prices until people stop paying,' plus a Weibo influencer calling it proof shoppers no longer blindly pay inflated brand premiums.

items.title: 스트레이 키즈 리노, 구찌 2026 크루즈 컬렉션 완벽 소화! 하퍼스 바자 커버 3종 공개
items.summary: Harper's Bazaar Korea unveils three cover images of Gucci global ambassador Lee Know (Stray Kids) styled in the 2026 Cruise collection, under the concept 'Real, Lee Know' juxtaposing his idol persona with his off-duty identity as a 20-something. Standard ambassador/editorial activation coverage.

items.title: '솔드아웃 킹' 방탄소년단 진, 구찌 캠페인 재킷→시카고 콘서트 티셔츠 품절 또 품절
items.summary: StarNews Korea reports BTS Jin's Gucci Primavera campaign leather jacket ($9,900) sold out across multiple markets within roughly a day, dubbing him the 'sellout king' after several consecutive merchandise sellouts tied to his ambassador activity, underscoring his commercial pull for the brand.

items.title: Fan account post on Jin's Gucci Primavera jacket sellout
items.summary: BTS Jin fan account post highlighting that his Gucci Primavera jacket sold out across Europe in under 24 hours despite the $9,900 price, with US/Korea stock reportedly down to two of nine sizes; representative of the dense fandom SNS volume around Gucci's K-pop ambassador activations.

items.title: BTS 진 x 구찌 화보 풀렸는데 진짜 미쳤다는 말밖에 안 나옴
items.summary: Korean Threads fan post praising BTS Jin's Gucci campaign photos as overshadowing the brand's own luxury image with his looks, calling the suit fit and gaze flawless; typical high-affect fandom sentiment rather than brand-neutral commentary.

items.title: 스트레이키즈 리노님의 구찌 팝업 행사 참석 사진
items.summary: Korean fan-community board post sharing photos of Lee Know at the Gucci Edit Room popup photo call at Shinsegae Gangnam; visible engagement was modest (99 views, 7 comments, 0 likes/scraps), showing genuine but small-scale organic community reach rather than viral volume. Included despite being outside the strict freshness window because same-week Korean community volume was thin.

items.title: 賛否両論のデムナの「グッチ」は10点満点中の何点？ 業界アナリストが辛口リポート
items.summary: WWD Japan covers Bernstein analyst scoring of Demna's Gucci debut collection (7.6/10), describing jackets and trousers as fine but shoes/bags 'uninteresting' and other pieces 'vulgar,' with heavy criticism of the leggings and show venue choice, presenting a rare analyst-sourced critical read of the new creative direction circulating in Japanese trade press.

items.title: Luxury sales plunge in China as tax push hits wealthy shoppers
items.summary: Jing Daily reports Beijing's offshore-wealth tax enforcement and a softer stock market drove double-digit July sales drops at Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci and Hermes in China, with Macau casino revenue (a proxy for high-roller spending) also falling sharply; wealthy Chinese consumers are described as newly cautious on discretionary luxury purchases.

items.title: 뎀나가 구찌의 엔진에 시동을 걸었다
items.summary: Vogue Korea profile of creative director Demna's approach at Gucci, describing his shift from Balenciaga-era conceptualism toward commercially desirable product, new sizing systems for diverse body types, and an in-house atelier for faster turnaround; frames his direction as chasing a cohesive 'Gucci feeling' of confidence and subtle rebellion. Predominantly favorable trade-editorial coverage.
